scope.purpose: A vertical stack of headings that each show or hide a section of content.
useCases: Settings or details sections on a long page.
exclusions: Sizes in v1 (one size; density adjusts spacing).
alternatives: Tabs when only one section is read at a time and sections are peers.
A Dialog or a page for long content.

fixtures: Phosphor glyphs re-exported by examples/icon/glyphs.ts for the leading icon example.

examples.preview: dist/previews/accordion.html (npm run build && npm run build:preview accordion)

decisionsTaken: One size: trigger in typography.label.lg (16 px, medium) at least size.control.lg (48 px) tall, content in typography.body.md; density adjusts the spacing. Sizes can be added later without breaking the API.
value is a list of expanded values in both modes; multiple false allows at most one expanded item, which can be collapsed (always collapsible).
Line-separated items (color.border.subtle, also above the first and below the last), hover tint color.item.hover.surface with radius.control, chevron in color.content.secondary rotating 180°.
headingLevel (2 to 6, default 3) wraps each trigger in a heading, per the WAI-ARIA accordion pattern.
Optional WAI-ARIA arrow keys included (Down, Up wrapping, Home, End), as Bits UI Accordion provides them.
Expansion animates the block size and the chevron over motion.duration.base; immediate under reduced motion.

Round 2: Accordion now uses Bits UI Accordion (state, headings, triggers, always-mounted content). Overrides kept by the contract-over-Bits rule and covered by browser tests: arrow keys limited to this accordion's enabled triggers (Bits UI runs over nested and collapsed ones); the content exposed as a region named by its trigger and aria-controls on the trigger (Bits UI sets neither). Bits UI 2.19.3 pinned.
The review page gains a Leading icons option (the slot existed but no option showed it).
nextAction: Wave 4 implementation gate pending: the user reviews the preview pages, then the approval is recorded.
implementationNotes: The focus ring is drawn inside the trigger (outline-offset of minus its width) so that it stays inside the accordion inline size, as the contract asks.
A heading level outside 2 to 6 falls back to 3.
